user.description: Configure GitHub Copilot. Use a supported GitHub token for the bundled local runtime, or connect to the authenticated GitHub Copilot Bridge add-on. For more information, visit the [documentation]({documentation_url}).

data_description.api_token: Fine-grained GitHub token or OAuth user token with Copilot access. Used only when no bridge URL is configured.
data_description.model: Copilot model ID. Use auto unless a specific model is required.
data_description.cli_url: Bridge hostname and port, such as a1b2c3d4-github-copilot-bridge:8000. Leave empty to use the SDK's bundled runtime.
data_description.connection_token: Shared secret configured in the bridge add-on. Required when a bridge URL is configured.
data_description.prompt: Templated instructions used for the Home Assistant conversation agent.
data_description.session_timeout: Seconds of inactivity before a Copilot conversation session is discarded.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your GitHub token is valid and has Copilot permissions. Ensure you have an active GitHub Copilot subscription.
error.connection: Unable to connect to the GitHub Copilot runtime. Verify the bridge URL and that the add-on is running.
error.invalid_url: Invalid bridge address. Enter a hostname and port, optionally prefixed with tcp://, http://, or https://.
error.token_required: GitHub Token is required when not using the Copilot Bridge add-on.
error.connection_token_required: Bridge Connection Token is required when using the Copilot Bridge add-on.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: GitHub Copilot is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

data_description.model: The AI model to use for conversations
data_description.ai_task_model: The AI model to use for stateless AI Tasks.
data_description.attachments_enabled: Allow explicit AI Task images to be sent to GitHub Copilot. Images leave the local network.
data_description.cli_url: Bridge hostname and port. Leave empty to use the SDK's bundled runtime.
data_description.connection_token: Shared secret configured in the bridge add-on.
data_description.max_attachment_bytes: Maximum normalized bytes allowed for each image.
data_description.max_attachments: Maximum number of images accepted by one AI Task.
data_description.max_image_dimension: Maximum width or height after normalization.
data_description.llm_hass_api: APIs whose Home Assistant tools Copilot may use. Leave empty for conversation-only mode.
data_description.max_tool_calls: Maximum Home Assistant tool attempts allowed during one conversation turn.
data_description.prompt: Templated instructions used for the Home Assistant conversation agent.
data_description.session_timeout: Seconds of inactivity before a Copilot conversation session is discarded.
data_description.timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for a Copilot response.
